description: Convert between a content hash URI (ipfs://, ipns://, bzz://, ar://, onion3://, sia://) and the hex value stored in an ENS contenthash record (ENSIP-7), both ways, and give an HTTP gateway URL for it. Give either uri or hex. Works offline.
name: convert_content_hash

gatewayUrl.description: An HTTP URL that serves the content

title: Convert content hashes
